availability.statement: Access depends on current Tiingo account entitlements; a 403 means this credential is not entitled to the requested capability.

common_pitfalls: Ticker symbols are case-sensitive in the URL -- always uppercase.
Intraday data is limited to recent history; check metadata for available date range.
get_realtime_price may return stale data outside market hours unless after_hours=True.
description: US and international equities with EOD historical prices, real-time IEX quotes, and intraday data.
ticker_format: Uppercase symbols, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, BRK-A
workflows: Fetch metadata first with get_stock_metadata to verify ticker validity and date range.
Use get_stock_prices for EOD OHLCV history; supports daily/weekly/monthly/annually resampling.
Use get_realtime_price for current IEX top-of-book price during market hours.
Use get_intraday_prices for sub-daily data at 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, or 1hour intervals.
